scope: H5-only DangoUI minimal experiment on Build publish sheet
positiveEvidence: DangoUI 3.6.16 is exact in package.json, pnpm lock, and installed package.
Global DangoUI CSS is imported before host themes.
DuInput, DuTextarea and DuButton are real named imports, registered consumers, present in the production bundle, and rendered as .du-* instances.
At 390 and 536 the three migrated controls are horizontally contained; input and textarea each expose one visible root boundary and zero native primitive border.
Name 15/16 and description 1000/1001 paths truncate through the preserved adapters and show the original limit toasts.
The long textarea is internally scrollable and a focus outline is visible in the focus proxy probe.

blockingFindings.evidence: At fresh 1280x720, textarea top/bottom=749.02/893.02 and actions top/bottom=907.02/955.02. The action row is outside the viewport and the screenshot visibly cuts the form below the name field.

The required pointer, Enter and Space probes through saveDraftFromSheet were not run because exact localStorage restoration and write interception were unavailable in the read-only browser evaluation surface.
Production fixes both props to false and no isolated non-production mount exists. Source inspection is not accepted as runtime proof.
Focus and reduced-space geometry were checked, but no real mobile virtual keyboard event/viewport resize was available.
All three CUA screenshots were captured and inspected, but the QA surface exposed no authorized filesystem persistence method.
